description.value: A biography of Sandra Day O'Connor who, in 1981, became the first woman appointed as Supreme Court justice.

title: Sandra Day O'Connor

first_sentence.value: With tears in her eyes, Sandra Day O'Connor spoke this oath before a courtroom packed with people, and then put on her black robes.
